legacy_yoyamic.purpose: staging workflow, legacy reference, migration source

auth_tenant_foundation.scope: email/password foundation, tenant context, roles, permissions, bearer sessions, protected API reads

part_360.scope: tenant-scoped Part 360 read model, stock availability, RFQ_ID links, supplier/customer quotes, orders, service history, documents, traceability, margin, non-persistent workflow boundaries

stock_360.scope: tenant-scoped Stock 360 read model, owner/company, supplier, tag info, traceability, documents, lifecycle, RFQ/quote/order links, reservation/movement/upload boundaries

company_inventory.scope: tenant-scoped company inventory summary with unique stock totals, company relationship rows, stock documents, linked RFQs, and non-persistent action boundaries

documents_certificates.scope: tenant-scoped document/version/link metadata, reusable DocumentPanel, Document Center UI, upload-intent validation, protected API contracts, sample-data-backed read models, no object storage or malware scanning yet

dashboard.scope: ACI770 ERP cockpit metrics, RFQs, quotes, supplier quotes, POs, sales orders, stock value, company inventory, service workflows, documents, accounting alerts, recent activity, quick actions
